jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Diamond Key International (DKI) is looking for an experienced Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of engineering and terminal automation projects across Africa. Based remotely in Namibia, you will be the primary interface between our customers and global project teams, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the highest quality standards.

What You'll Do

• Lead end-to-end project execution from project award through commissioning and handover
• Act as the primary customer focal point throughout the project lifecycle
• Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks and commercial performance
• Coordinate engineering, procurement, subcontractors and site activities across multiple countries
• Drive stakeholder engagement and maintain strong customer relationships
• Provide accurate project forecasting, reporting and governance to senior management
• Mentor project teams and promote continuous improvement

What We're Looking For

• 3-5 years' experience managing engineering, industrial automation or Oil & Gas projects with project management experience
• Experience with EPC, systems integration or automation is highly desirable
• Have a Bachelor's Degree in Mechatronics Engineering (preferred) or engineering related discipline
• Proven track record delivering complex technical projects across multiple stakeholders
• Strong commercial awareness with experience managing project budgets and margins
• Excellent leadership, communication and customer management skills including vendors and client coordination
• Fluent in English and local language
• Experience working across Africa or multinational environments is highly desirable
• Willingness to travel within the region when required
• Experience covering operational delivery, logistics, client management and site activities in fuel terminals or TAS, equipment deployment, commissioning is an added advantage
• Only applicants with Namibia citizenship will be considered

Why Join DKI

• Work on complex terminal automation and industrial digitalisation projects
• Regional role supporting leading customers across Africa
• Collaborate with engineering teams across multiple countries
• Opportunity to influence project delivery standards and customer success
• Supportive, collaborative and growth-focused culture

Interested?

Apply with your latest CV and join us in delivering world-class automation solutions across
Africa.

This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

Think Jam is an entertainment creative agency focused on engaging major fandoms and franchises through social media marketing. The organization collaborates with studios, streamers, and intellectual property holders to transform marketing channels into active community spaces for entertainment. Operating globally with a remote team, the company emphasizes innovation and the integration of emerging technologies to advance entertainment marketing.

About the Opportunity:

The INTEGRATED MARKETING PROJECT MANAGER will oversee the planning, coordination, and delivery of marketing campaigns and projects. This role bridges project management, campaign execution, marketing operations, and performance reporting to ensure efficient delivery, adherence to deadlines, and clear communication of results. Prepare weekly client status updates and support monthly and quarterly business reviews.

3 to 5 years of experience in marketing operations, project management, integrated marketing, or related fields.
Proven ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in fast-paced environments, preferably agencies or client services.
Strong analytical skills with experience in campaign performance data, KPIs, and reporting.
Proficiency in Airtable, including building and managing bases, workflows, and automations.
Excellent organizational skills with attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, capable of preparing client-facing reports and presentations.
Proactive and resourceful approach with the ability to work collaboratively and take ownership.

jobs.description:
Company Description

It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive
. As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery
and minimally invasive care
, our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system
and Ion
—have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.

We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.

The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.

If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare
, you’ll find your purpose here.

Job Description

Primary Function of Position

The Project Manager / Senior Project Manager, Advanced Tissue Models will be responsible for a diverse set of products and activities for the Advanced Tissue Models (ATM) group within the Global Learning Products organization. The Project Manager / Senior Project Manager will be responsible for leading new product development and sustaining engineering initiatives and will coordinate departmental or cross-functional teams, focused on delivering new or upgrading existing products. The Project Manager / Senior Project Manager will coordinate activities during new product development, production cut-in, go-to-market, and post go-live phases of the product lifecycle and is required to have excellent communication and customer-service skills to effectively interact with multiple teams, including Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Finance, Logistics, Customer Training, Surgeon KOLs, and other stakeholders.

Essential Job Duties

Lead cross-functional teams for new product development and product revision efforts. Responsibilities and tasks will include:
Monitor the project from initiation through delivery and post-launch customer support activities.
Create and maintain project plans, dashboards, and schedules.
Develop and monitor project budgets.
Ensure projects adhere to the ATM Design Control process and lead phase gate activities.
Organize cross-functional activities, ensuring completion of the project (i.e., product delivered on schedule and within budget constraints).
Organize and manage team meetings, design reviews, and phase gate exit review boards.
Participate in portfolio reviews and provide clear project updates including status, risks, mitigations, etc.

Support in defining and aligning project goals with business unit and corporate objectives. Organize and prioritize the work of the teams to accomplish the objectives.
Support team members, including functional managers across the business, to plan and execute the activities required to achieve project goals.
Support resource demand planning for project teams including estimating project work efforts, needs, roles, and responsibilities.
Work with Operations and Manufacturing to determine strategies for product cut-ins.
Work with Logistics, Regulatory, and Customer Training to determine the global distribution plan.
Support product management with requirements development, go-to-market, and post-launch activities.
Coordinate and communicate effectively with other project managers and core teams leading new solution or new indication development with ATM dependencies to ensure alignment on project goals, priorities, scope, resources, budget, and timelines.
Maintain the ATM project management ecosystem, facilitate best practices, and drive process improvements.
Additional job duties and tasks as determined by the functional people manager.

Qualifications

Required Skills and Experience

5+ years of experience in project management, preferably in new product development and commercialization.
Experience leading complex projects in medical device, engineering, or other clinical fields.
Proven ability in overseeing new product development through Design Controls and demonstrated success in supporting product launches.
Strategic thinker with strong business and financial acumen and demonstrated experience in data-driven decision making.
Exceptional communicator and influencer with a track record of cross-functional collaboration to ensure project success.
Experience working with KOLs, healthcare stakeholders, and executives, with the ability to present tailored information in a clear and concise manner to various leadership audiences.
Ability to thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous, high-growth environments.
Ability to lead multiple projects simultaneously and handle ambiguity.
Ability to travel up to 10%.

Required Education And Training

BS degree engineering, business, health sciences, or other scientific field. MS degree preferred.

Working Conditions

Non specified

Preferred Skills And Experience

Certification in project management (PMP).
Experience in medical device or other regulated industries.
Experience in or certification in change management and negotiation.
Experience supporting product launches for multiple markets and working with Regulatory, Global Trade, and Logistics teams to ensure successful global product distribution.

Additional Information

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19. Details can vary by role.

Intuitive is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We provide equal employment opportunities to all qualified applicants and employees, and prohibit discrimination and harassment of any type, without regard to race, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, color, age, religion, protected veteran or disability status, genetic information or any other status protected under federal, state, or local applicable laws.

743.13(b)), some roles at Intuitive Surgical may be subject to U.S. export controls for prospective employees who are nationals from countries currently on embargo or sanctions status.

Certain information you provide as part of the application will be used for purposes of determining whether Intuitive Surgical will need to (i) obtain an export license from the U.S. Government on your behalf (note: the government’s licensing process can take 3 to 6+ months) or (ii) implement a Technology Control Plan (“TCP”) (note: typically adds 2 weeks to the hiring process).

Description

En tant que Project Manager – AI & Data Transformation, vous coordonnez et optimisez la réalisation, le déploiement et la montée en puissance des modèles d’IA/GenAI et des solutions axées sur les données au sein des projets de transformation compliance et business connexes de Belfius (avec un focus central actuel sur KYC, AML, S&E). Vous travaillez dans une équipe transversale et assurez l’orientation entre les équipes data science, IT, compliance et les parties prenantes business afin de réaliser une adoption de l’IA efficace, conforme et à fort impact.

Vous veillez à une intégration fluide des modèles d’IA (en collaboration avec des équipes data science distinctes) dans les processus existants, surveillez les performances et optimisez les stratégies de déploiement afin de répondre à la réglementation, à la gestion des risques et aux objectifs business—tout en maintenant la transparence, l’auditabilité et les standards éthiques de l’IA.

Votre job en deux mots

Responsabilités principales :

Coordination & Gouvernance
Gérez une feuille de route intégrée IA/GenAI pour les projets de transformation compliance et business, alignée sur les objectifs stratégiques de Belfius et les exigences légales.
Impliquez et orientez activement les équipes data science, IT, compliance et les partenaires externes afin d’assurer l’adhésion, l’engagement et une adoption éthique de l’IA.
Veillez au respect de la réglementation IA, des politiques internes et des directives éthiques, avec un accent sur la gestion proactive des risques (ex. : mitigation des biais, explicabilité, confidentialité des données).
Coordonnez les dépendances et synergies entre les initiatives IA/GenAI, les projets compliance (KYC, AML) et les processus business afin d’éviter les duplications et de maximiser l’efficacité.

Collaboration & Optimisation des processus
Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes business pour traduire les besoins en solutions IA (ex. : automatisation des contrôles KYC, amélioration de la détection de fraude).
Créez des tableaux de bord/procès-verbaux pour suivre l’impact de l’IA sur les résultats business (ex. : moins de faux positifs, onboarding plus rapide).
Proposez des améliorations aux workflows IA, aux outils et aux modèles de collaboration sur base des données de performance.

Pilotage axé sur les données & technique
Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes data science pour surveiller les performances des modèles, réentraîner les algorithmes et garantir l’amélioration continue.
Collaborez avec les équipes IT et cybersécurité pour sécuriser l’infrastructure IA, les pipelines de données et les environnements de déploiement.
Promouvez l’utilisation responsable de l’IA, y compris la détection des biais, les évaluations d’équité et le reporting de transparence.
Exploitez l’analyse de données et les tableaux de bord pour suivre l’impact de l’IA sur les résultats business, l’efficacité compliance et l’expérience client.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants :

Expérience & Connaissances :

Minimum 2 ans d’expérience pratique en développement de modèles IA/ML, déploiement ou data science, de préférence dans les services financiers, la compliance ou les secteurs réglementés.
Expérience avec les outils GenAI (ex. : LLMs, RAG, Copilot) et le prompt engineering pour des applications compliance.
Familiarité avec la réglementation compliance (AMLD, RGPD, MiFID) et les processus bancaires (KYC, monitoring des opérations) est un atout.

Compétences :

Esprit orienté résolution de problèmes pour déboguer les modèles, optimiser les performances et réagir aux nouveaux défis.
Solides compétences en communication pour expliquer les concepts IA à des parties prenantes non techniques (ex. : Compliance Officers, équipes business).
Précision pour la qualité des données, la validation des modèles et le respect de la réglementation.
Proactif et collaboratif—capable de travailler de manière autonome tout en impliquant des équipes transversales.
Volonté d’apprentissage continu pour rester à la pointe des tendances, outils et réglementations IA.

Compétences linguistiques :

Néerlandais ou français : courant (oral et écrit).
Anglais : excellente maîtrise (documentation technique, collaboration internationale).

Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :

Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

jobs.description:
ABOUT US

BGTS is a software and technology solutions company
, powered by over 1,800 professionals
. With more than 25 years of experience in digital transformation & engineering, technology consulting, and enterprise service management
, we empower our clients to achieve success through a combination of engineering expertise and industry insight
.
Our strategically located engineering centres and group companies in London, Sheffield, Amsterdam, Düsseldorf
, and other key locations provide flexibility, speed, and convenience, enabling us to deliver tailored, impactful solutions
to clients around the world.
BGTS is committed to creating value for enterprises by offering high-quality, customer-centric, and results-driven
solutions. The company has received multiple international awards and is recognised as one of the largest independent software companies in its region.

We’re looking for a Project Manager for our leading client to lead complex IT projects in the finance sector, implement agile methodologies. The role is onsite, based in Amsterdam.

Your role:

The Project Manager is end responsible for project governance and related policies and procedures, proper planning, prioritization and active project management of complex IT project portfolio.
This role requires an experienced professional who thrives in a dynamic environment and is skilled at using JIRA and Confluence to drive project visibility, communication, and collaboration.
First and foremost, the Project Manager will ensure the roadmaps/plans focus on agreed business priorities and dependencies based on business needs, and delivers against the shared objectives and main activities with key milestones that have been agreed upon. To this end, the Project Manager will support business case creation, drive key requirements gathering from business & stakeholders scope work, institutionalize governance, planning and cadence for the portfolio or project(s).
The Project Manager will also actively contribute to improvement of the Project Management Office with his/her experience in Project Management.

Key Responsibilities:

Lead complex IT projects in Finance area (e.g. complex change / transformational initiatives within the organization, mainly software projects).
Set priorities, create the plan, and allocate resources within the PMO, according to strategic priorities.
Responsible for managing every phase of complex companywide projects, specifically:
Drive vision for projects towards clear business objectives, scope, requirements & success criteria, including the identification of opportunities to improve the impact & experience for our customers, translating into business cases and getting buy-in from leadership
Create clear planning documents together with involved departments
Proactive identification and management of relevant dependencies (both within as well as cross departments and 3rd parties) in order to minimize risks and challenges.
Regular tracking and reporting status and progress of all streams of work, highlighting where required, risk/issues to governance groups or team members
Enables teams & leaders to make quality decisions and support in prioritization exercises
Defines, executes and maintains internal and external governance, with objective of creating transparency and facilitate decision making through clear processes and accountability
Work in partnership with business units and functions leadership to ensure resources are allocated to the right work, within headcount and budget.
Agile Project Management: Lead and manage multiple projects using agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.), ensuring effective sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning. Ensure that teams are empowered and equipped to work efficiently.
JIRA/Confluence Management: Use JIRA to manage project workflows, track progress, assign tasks, and ensure transparency across all teams. Create and manage Confluence documentation to facilitate knowledge sharing, project updates, and process documentation.
Team Collaboration: Facilitate agile ceremonies (daily standups, sprint planning, retrospectives, etc.) and promote effective communication and collaboration across development, product, and business teams. Mentor and support team members to ensure continuous improvement.
Stakeholder Management: Build strong relationships with key stakeholders, including product owners, process owners, and internal clients. Provide clear and actionable project updates using JIRA dashboards and Confluence reports, ensuring that all stakeholders are aligned with project objectives.
Project Planning & Execution: Oversee the full lifecycle of agile projects, including scope definition, resource allocation, timeline management, and risk mitigation. Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.
Progress Monitoring & Reporting: Regularly update JIRA boards and Confluence pages to track project progress, document outcomes, and highlight key performance indicators (KPIs). Prepare and present project status reports for senior leadership and stakeholders.
Risk Management: Proactively identify risks and issues impacting project timelines, quality, or scope. Develop mitigation strategies and escalate issues as needed to keep projects on track.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous learning and improvement by encouraging the use of agile best practices and promoting a feedback-driven environment. Lead retrospectives to identify opportunities for process optimization

Requirements

Skills/Qualifications:

Experience:

6-10 years of experience in project management, with at least 4 years managing agile projects using JIRA and Confluence. Proven track record in successfully managing complex projects in a fast-paced environment.
Skills/Qualifications:
Agile Expertise: Strong experience with agile frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, etc.) and a deep understanding of agile principles. Scrum Master certification or similar credentials are preferred.
JIRA/Confluence Expertise: Advanced proficiency in JIRA for managing backlogs, sprints, and project tracking.
Project Management Skills: Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with strong organizational and time-management skills.
Have a solid business understanding. Independently use quantitative and qualitative data to drive decision-making and lead by example
Analytical skills and mastery of data handling, able to tell a clear story with data/insights
Experience in managing 3rd Party Vendors in IT projects

Job Description: Technical Project Manager Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) & AI

Role Overview
InfoBeans is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with a strong engineering background, AI/ML expertise, and proven leadership capabilities to manage and lead a 40+ member engineering team supporting BFSI.

The ideal candidate will combine technical depth, project and delivery management, client engagement, and a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) mindset. Beyond managing delivery against defined requirements, the candidate will work closely with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for innovation, and rapidly translate ideas into working technical solutions using AI, automation, and modern engineering practices.

The role requires hands-on familiarity with Python, Django, Databticks, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and agentic AI development. The candidate should be capable of engaging with business and technology stakeholders, guiding engineering teams through solution discovery and prototyping, and converting successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Project & Delivery Management
Lead and manage a 50+ member engineering team, ensuring predictable delivery, quality, productivity, and client satisfaction.
Own end-to-end delivery governance, including planning, estimation, resource allocation, risk management, dependencies, budgets, and delivery metrics.
Establish effective engineering processes, delivery standards, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.
Work closely with engineering leads, architects, business analysts, and client stakeholders to resolve technical and delivery challenges.
Build a strong ownership culture focused on outcomes, accountability, collaboration, and continuous learning.
2. Forward Deployed Engineering & Client Partnership
Engage directly with client business and technology stakeholders to understand business objectives, operational challenges, and emerging requirements.
Proactively identify opportunities where AI, automation, data engineering, and modern software engineering can deliver measurable business value.
Facilitate discovery workshops, technical discussions, and solution-design sessions to translate business problems into actionable engineering solutions.
Rapidly develop prototypes and POCs to validate ideas, demonstrate feasibility, and accelerate client decision-making.
Bridge the gap between business needs and engineering execution, helping transform exploratory opportunities into funded projects and higher-value engineering engagements.
Build trusted client relationships by demonstrating technical credibility, business understanding, and a solution-oriented approach.
3. AI/ML, Agentic AI & Modern Engineering
Drive the identification, design, and development of AI/ML-based POCs addressing real-world business and technology challenges.
Demonstrate practical knowledge of Python and Django, including the ability to review code, guide implementation, and troubleshoot technical issues.
Lead or guide the development of AI-powered applications, LLM-based solutions, AI agents, and agentic workflows.
Apply Spec-Driven Development (SDD) and AI-assisted engineering practices to improve development speed, consistency, quality, and maintainability.
Encourage the use of coding assistants, AI agents, automated testing, and modern developer productivity tools across engineering teams.
Evaluate POCs for technical feasibility, security, scalability, performance, and readiness for production deployment.
Establish reusable patterns, reference architectures, and engineering practices that support repeatable AI-led solution delivery.
4. Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence
Provide technical direction to engineering teams and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, coding standards, security requirements, and engineering best practices.
Work with architects and senior engineers on solution design, technical decision-making, integration, and non-functional requirements.
Promote hands-on problem-solving and maintain sufficient technical depth to challenge assumptions, review proposed solutions, and guide teams effectively.
Drive collaboration across application engineering, data engineering, QA automation, DevOps, and AI/ML teams.
Ensure that AI-enabled solutions meet applicable financial-services security, privacy, governance, and compliance requirements.
5. Stakeholder Management & Business Growth
Communicate effectively with senior client stakeholders, internal leadership, and cross-functional teams.
Present technical proposals, POC demonstrations, solution roadmaps, delivery updates, and business-value outcomes.
Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements through innovation, solution-led discussions, and measurable business outcomes.
Collaborate with account leadership and business development teams to shape proposals, estimates, solution approaches, and new engineering opportunities.
Track and communicate business impact through metrics such as productivity improvement, cycle-time reduction, quality, cost optimization, and value delivered.
Required Skills & Experience
Experience: 15+ years in the IT industry, with substantial experience in technical project management, engineering leadership, and enterprise application delivery.
Team Leadership: Proven experience managing large engineering teams, preferably 4050+ members, in complex client environments.
Programming: Strong hands-on experience with Python and practical exposure to Django or related Python web frameworks.
AI/ML: Demonstrated experience building AI/ML proof of concepts, with the ability to translate business problems into working technical prototypes.
Generative AI & Agentic Development: Practical exposure to LLM-based applications, AI agents, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted software development.
Spec-Driven Development: Understanding and practical experience with SDD, including translating requirements into specifications, implementation plans, and testable engineering outcomes.
FDE Mindset: Experience engaging directly with clients, conducting discovery, solving ambiguous problems, prototyping solutions, and driving ideas toward implementation.
Technical Architecture: Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Delivery Management: Strong capabilities in project planning, estimation, risk management, governance, stakeholder alignment, and delivery execution.
Communication: Excellent verbal, written, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience in banking, financial services, or other regulated enterprise environments.
Familiarity with banking technology, risk management, financial operations, or enterprise transformation initiatives.
Experience working with global clients and distributed onsite/offshore engineering teams.
Exposure to cloud platforms, data engineering, RAG-based applications, AI evaluation, observability, and secure enterprise AI adoption.
Experience converting innovation initiatives and POCs into production solutions or larger engineering engagements.
Relevant technical, cloud, AI/ML, or project-management certifications are an advantage.
Key Success Measures
Successful leadership and delivery of the 50+ member engineering team.
Improved delivery predictability, engineering productivity, quality, and client satisfaction.
Identification and validation of high-value business problems through client discovery.
Successful development and demonstration of AI/ML POCs and agentic solutions.
Adoption of SDD and AI-assisted engineering practices across relevant teams.
Conversion of validated POCs into production implementations and incremental engineering opportunities.
Strong client relationships and recognition as a trusted technical and business partner.

Job Description

On the battlefield, success depends on accurate and timely intel. As an Army National Guard Intelligence Analyst, you will play a key role in the interpretation and exploitation of information gathered from or about the threat. Intelligence Analysts provide Guard personnel with information about enemy forces and potential battle areas, and use information derived from all intelligence disciplines to determine changes in enemy capabilities, vulnerabilities, and probable courses of action. You’ll gain Military Intelligence training, education, and a security clearance that could open doors to rewarding career opportunities with other intelligence agencies.

Specific duties of the Intelligence Analyst may include: preparing all-source intelligence products; providing Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) Synchronization support; processing incoming reports and messages; determining the significance and reliability of incoming information; establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-referencing intelligence records and files; integrating incoming information with current intelligence holdings; and preparing and maintaining enemy situational graphics.

Job Duties

Preparing all-source intelligence products to support the combat commander
Assessing the significance and reliability of incoming intelligence collection
Establishing and maintaining systematic, cross-reference intelligence records and files

Some Of The Skills You’ll Learn

Critical thinking
The ability to use sophisticated mapping tools, intelligence networks, and systems to identify the evolving threat on the battlefield
Gather information utilizing premier digital and analytical tools to create products for the Commander

Helpful Skills

Analytical thinking; gathering information, and understanding of relevancy
Interest in reading maps and charts

More than any other branch of service, the Army National Guard offers a wide range of intelligence-related positions. Through your training, you will develop skills and experience to create opportunities for a civilian career with federal agencies like the National Security Agency.

Earn While You Learn

Instead of paying to learn these skills, get paid to learn. In the Army National Guard, you will learn these valuable job skills while earning a regular paycheck and qualifying for tuition assistance and certifications. jobs.description:
About Gartner IT:

Join a world-class team of skilled engineers who build creative digital solutions to support our colleagues and clients.  We make a broad organizational impact by delivering cutting-edge technology solutions that power Gartner.  Gartner IT values its culture of nonstop innovation, an outcome-driven approach to success, and the notion that great ideas can come from anyone on the team. 

About The Role 

Gartner’s Information Security Team is a group of passionate information security professionals dedicated to Protecting, Detecting, and Responding to threats. Our team is filled with lifelong learners who are consistently researching ways to better defend and stay ahead of the threats of tomorrow. We are a collaborative group, where good ideas come together whether they come from the most experienced or the newest members of the team. 

We're looking for a well-rounded and motivated Lead Security Analyst to join our Human Cyber Risk & Assessment Team. In this critical role, you'll be instrumental in safeguarding our organization from human-centric cyber threats. You'll leverage your expertise in information security best practices to identify, assess, and mitigate risks associated with human behavior, ensuring the protection of our sensitive data and systems. This is an excellent opportunity for a professional with 5-7 years of experience in Information Security who is passionate about proactive security measures and building a strong security posture.

What you will do:

Conduct comprehensive assessments of human-centric cyber risks, identifying vulnerabilities and potential attack vectors tied to human actors like phishing, social engineering, and insider threats.
Design, implement, and manage Data Loss Prevention (DLP) strategies and controls to prevent unauthorized disclosure or exfiltration of sensitive information. You'll also monitor DLP alerts, investigate incidents, and recommend remediation steps.
Develop and implement programs to detect, analyze, and mitigate insider risks, including monitoring user behavior and collaborating with relevant stakeholders (e.g., HR, Legal) on incident response.
Stay ahead of current attack vectors, trends, and techniques used by threat actors targeting human vulnerabilities, proactively identifying emerging threats and recommending countermeasures.
Advocate for and ensure adherence to information security best practices across the organization, especially regarding human behavior and data handling.
Configure, monitor, and optimize security tools relevant to human cyber risk.
Support during security incidents related to human-centric threats, assisting with investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery efforts.
Contribute to the development and delivery of security awareness training programs to educate employees on human cyber risks and best practices.
Generate reports on human cyber risk posture, incident metrics, and the effectiveness of security controls, while maintaining accurate documentation of security processes.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including IT Operations, Legal, HR, and other security teams, to achieve security objectives.
Present Security Risk Findings to Leadership
Assist with mentoring Junior Level Analyst

What you will need:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field (relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree).
5-7 years of hands-on experience in Information Security, with a focus on human cyber risk, data loss prevention, and insider threat.
Strong understanding of information security best practices, frameworks (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001), and regulatory requirements.
In-depth knowledge of Data Loss Prevention (DLP) principles, technologies, and implementation strategies.
Proven experience with Insider Risk Management methodologies and tools.
Familiarity with current attack vectors tied to human actors, including phishing, social engineering, business email compromise (BEC), and malware delivery.

Must have:

Technical & Data Security Capabilities

Hands-on experience with Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and Data Security Posture Management (DSPM) platforms to govern unstructured data and prevent exfiltration.
Experience with Email Security platforms and Endpoint Protection tools (device control, USB policy enforcement, local storage monitoring).
Proficiency in analyzing data security telemetry across cloud platforms (e.g., M365 Purview, Google Workspace, OneDrive/SharePoint).

Human Cyber Risk & Governance

Experience analyzing human risk indicators, insider threat telemetry, or security awareness campaign metrics (e.g., phishing performance, EDP training completions).
Understanding of Acceptable Use Policies (AUP) and experience managing risk-based exception workflows without causing business disruption.

Professional & Analytical Skills

Strong analytical skills with a proven track record of investigating data security alerts, performing root-cause analysis, and evaluating complex employee risk profiles.
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, specifically the ability to conduct empathetic yet firm security remediations with employees and present risk insights to leadership (HR, Legal, IT).
Self-starter with the ability to manage independent investigations while collaborating seamlessly across a global security organization.

Nice to have:

Relevant security certifications (e.g., CISSP, CISM, GSEC, Security+, SSAP).

Who you are:

A lifelong learner with a desire for continuous personal and professional development.
Someone with proven communication, collaboration, and critical thinking skills.
Able to build trusting, meaningful relationships with peers, stakeholders, partners, and suppliers.
Capable of defining and communicating risk in a business-relevant language to both non-technical and technical audiences including Leadership teams.
Someone who can apply expert knowledge to solve complex business/technical issues.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles!

What you will get:

Competitive compensation.
Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
Ongoing mentorship and apprenticeship; Leadership courses, development programs, technical courses, certification opportunities and more!
A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
A chance to make an impact – your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
Hybrid Work Environment - enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
20+ PTO days plus holidays and floating holidays in your first year.
Extensive medical, dental insurance and vision plan.
401K with corporate match, immediate vesting.
Health-and-wellness-related allowance programs.
Parental leave.
Tuition reimbursement.
Employee Stock Purchase Plan.
Employee Assistance Program.
Gartner Gives Charity Match. And much more!

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

Job Number: R0251539

All-Source Intelligence Analyst

The Opportunity:

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our government every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an All-Source Intelligence Analyst, you use your specialized experience and attention to detail to give your client the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills.

As an All-Source Analyst on our team, you will perform ICD-compliant analysis with a focus on supporting the U.S. nuclear enterprise. You will analyze the current and anticipated military capabilities of foreign nations and craft analysis to support U.S. programs to mitigate future threats. You will participate in collection activities supporting strategic and tactical intelligence priorities and responses to military contingency operations and support analysis of missiles and delivery systems, advanced weapons, and related military activities and operations. You will generate analytic lines and written intelligence products in accordance with IC tradecraft standards using a wide range of intelligence resources and tools, brief analysis to senior DoD leaders, and produce white papers and short- and long-term assessments.

This is a chance to grow your expertise and broaden your skill set. You’ll share your expertise with other analysts through leadership and mentoring. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources to learn new skills and tools.

Work with us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our nation's leaders.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

8+ years of experience with intelligence analysis, U.S. government all-source analytic production, or specialized intelligence analysis training
Experience authoring products utilizing ICD 203 and ICD 206 tradecraft standards
Experience analyzing military weapons systems
Ability to work independently and in a fast-paced, collaborative environment

Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
HS diploma or GED and 12+ years of experience with analysis, or Bachelor’s degree and 8+ years of experience with analysis

Experience with all-source intelligence analysis and production in support of the U.S. nuclear enterprise or the National Labs
Experience working with U.S. military operations

The Territory Planning & Analytics (“TP&A”) team is at the center of Gartner’s mission-critical priorities. We partner with corporate and senior Sales and Services leaders to ensure the best return on the company’s substantial investment globally. The team serves as an internal consulting team for salesforce growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, market opportunity assessment, and the design of Sales and Services territories.

This role will be a part of the Territory Planning & Analytics (TPA) team in the broader Global Sales Strategy & Operations (GSSO) organization. Partner with Gartner's Services leaders to define growth needs and design territories that align with corporate services strategy and guidelines
Analyze internal and external data to identify trends and characterize market opportunity at various levels (e.g., region, industry, local area, company) to inform the design strategy
Provide Services managers & leaders with detailed description of respective territories to enable effective communication and planning with their team on their territories
Independently and completely own high-complexity analytical projects that entail detailed analysis of territory and retention data to provide senior services leaders information and advice to maximize revenue and margin
Run annual and monthly processes to identify opportunities for efficiency and growth and help services leaders achieve retention targets
Facilitate decision-making by modeling potential scenarios related to allocation of services professionals, current clients and prospects
Drive regular and multiple custom data analyses to inform decision-making of Gartner's services leaders and C-level executives
Collaborate with TP&A managers and leaders to independently and fully support one or more services regions as described
Establish and share best practices related to creating and optimizing services territories

Exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills to enable direct and frequent conversations with senior leaders in Gartner (VP/RVP/SVP/GVP level)

Demonstrated ability to form relationships with and influence senior leaders
Ability to deal with ambiguity and independently own project from start to finish

The Opportunity:

As a data analyst, you love diving into data and turning it into meaningful insights. With the abundance of structured and unstructured data, you understand the importance of transforming complex data sets into useful information to solve challenges. We need a data analyst like you to bring your knowledge to USCENTCOM’s data lake environment to support machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence development campaigns to improve intelligence for our nation’s warfighters.

As a client-facing data analyst on our Joint and Partner Forces market team, you’ll work closely with your clients to understand their questions and needs and then dig into their data-rich environments to help find the pieces of their information puzzle. Not only will you extract and evaluate their data, you’ll also help your client interpret the information and recommend how it can be used to make an impact on worldwide military operations, reducing risk to our military members and increasing mission success.

Work with us to help drive large-scale business and process decisions through data insights.

What You’ll Work On:

Use your technical knowledge to support client and stakeholder relationships in USCENTCOM.
Research, develop, and test data methodologies and generate cross-functional solutions through collection, interpretation, evaluation, and analysis of large data sets.
Contribute to impactful work and guide decision-making across multiple organizations.
Apply your communication skills and analytical mindset by simplifying technical requirements and trends, based on audience.
Present data findings and recommendations to clients and stakeholders using your knowledge of databases, scripting languages such as SQL, Python, or R, and Microsoft Office suite.
Establish quantitative and qualitative metrics and key performance indicators to drive technical outcomes.
Apply data visualization through different formats such as graphs, tables, and PowerPoint slides.
Grow your communication and technical skills by creating data-centric solutions across leading Joint Combatant Command.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

2+ years of experience designing algorithms and data manipulation capabilities using programming languages such as R, Python, or SQL
Knowledge of how to identify new sources of data and methods to improve data collection, analysis, and reporting
Ability to develop data pipelines and integrate data tools and solutions to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers to monitor and report on data
Ability to work collaboratively with intelligence and data analysis teams to produce qualitative and quantitative data that support intelligence products
Active TS/SCI clearance; willingness to take a polygraph exam
Bachelor’s degree in a Computer Science field

Experience with distributed data or computing tools, including MapReduce, Hadoop, Hive, EMR, Kafka, Spark, Gurobi, or MySQL

Experience supporting Joint Combatant Commands or other DoD organizations
Experience with C++, JavaScript, and Go programming languages

Als Project Manager – AI & Data Transformatie coördineer en optimaliseer je de implementatie, verdere uitrol en opschaling van AI/GenAI-modellen en datagedreven oplossingen binnen de Compliance- en aanverwante business transformatieprojecten van Belfius (met als huidige kernfocus KYC, AML, S&E). Coördinatie & Governance
Beheer een geïntegreerde AI/GenAI-roadmap voor compliance- en business transformatieprojecten, afgestemd op de strategische doelstellingen van Belfius en de wettelijke vereisten.

Maak gebruik van data-analyse en dashboards om de impact van AI op businessresultaten, compliance-doeltreffendheid en klantervaring te volgen.

jobs.description:
Global Sales & Services Operations (GSSO) is the team that helps shape Gartner's mission-critical sales and services priorities and works with sales and services leaders to drive tactical and analytical insights. As an associate on the GSSO team, you'll be at the forefront of the ongoing transformation of Gartner's Sales and Services teams, which delivers approximately $5.3B in annual business and technology insights revenue. You will partner with business leaders across Gartner to support global Sales and Services teams comprising nearly 9,000 associates and which sell to and service every major function across the enterprise.

About the role:

The Territory Planning & Analytics (“TP&A”) team is at the center of Gartner’s mission-critical priorities. We partner with corporate and senior Sales and Services leaders to ensure the best return on the company’s substantial investment globally. The team serves as an internal consulting team for salesforce growth strategy, go-to-market strategy, market opportunity assessment, and the design of Sales and Services territories.

This role will be a part of the Territory Planning & Analytics (TPA) team in the broader Global Sales Strategy & Operations (GSSO) organization. You will partner with leaders across Gartner's global Client Services Organization to determine where, when and how the company should optimize its substantial investment in Services professionals. The TP&A team enables Services leaders to focus more of their time on developing their teams and driving business results by acting as a key advisor to guide strategic and tactical decision-making at the regional and local levels regarding the design of services territories and associate productivity.

What you will do:

Partner with Gartner's Services leaders to define growth needs and design territories that align with corporate services strategy and guidelines
Analyze internal and external data to identify trends and characterize market opportunity at various levels (e.g., region, industry, local area, company) to inform the design strategy
Provide Services managers & leaders with detailed description of respective territories to enable effective communication and planning with their team on their territories
Independently and completely own high-complexity analytical projects that entail detailed analysis of territory and retention data to provide senior services leaders information and advice to maximize revenue and margin
Run annual and monthly processes to identify opportunities for efficiency and growth and help services leaders achieve retention targets
Facilitate decision-making by modeling potential scenarios related to allocation of services professionals, current clients and prospects
Drive regular and multiple custom data analyses to inform decision-making of Gartner's services leaders and C-level executives
Collaborate with TP&A managers and leaders to independently and fully support one or more services regions as described
Establish and share best practices related to creating and optimizing services territories

What you will need:

1+ years of management consulting or analytics experience required
Exceptional analytical skills, including high proficiency with Microsoft Excel, databases, etc.
Analytical skills include running regression analysis, modeling scenarios, testing hypotheses and working with non-conforming data sets, generating analytical insights etc.
Exceptionally strong written and verbal communication skills to enable direct and frequent conversations with senior leaders in Gartner (VP/RVP/SVP/GVP level)
PowerBI experience required, SQL and Python is preferred
Demonstrated ability to form relationships with and influence senior leaders
Ability to deal with ambiguity and independently own project from start to finish

What you will get:

Competitive salary, generous paid time off policy, charity match program, Medical, Dental & Vision Plans, Parental Leave, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), 401K matching, and more!

#GSSO

Who are we?

At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.

Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.

Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.

What makes Gartner a great place to work?

Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.

We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.

Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.

We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.

Gartner is the world authority on AI

At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.

It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.

What do we offer?

Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.

In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.

Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

GFT

GFT’s Environmental team delivers integrated planning, permitting, design and compliance solutions that support infrastructure development across North America. Collaborate with business leaders to recruit, retain, and deploy environmental talent effectively.
Support workforce planning initiatives that anticipate growth, succession, and evolving market needs.

Champion safety, quality, ethics, and corporate values across project teams and business operations.
Strengthen collaboration among offices, disciplines, and business units to improve delivery, consistency, and organizational performance.

jobs.description:
Description

Who is USP?

The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.

At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.

USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.

Brief Job Overview

The Associate Program Analyst serves as a key operational and programmatic partner to the Director and Equity Office team, supporting the implementation of the Equity Equals Excellence Strategy through project coordination, stakeholder engagement, research, communications, data analysis, and operational support. The position plays a critical role in translating strategic priorities into action by coordinating initiatives, maintaining systems and processes, supporting governance structures, and ensuring the effective execution of Equity Office programs and services.

How will YOU create impact here at USP?

Technical ability to review designs, challenge vendor proposals and resolve delivery issues.

Experience within supply chain, logistics or distribution operations.

Experience with Extreme Networks, Cisco or equivalent networking technologies.

Autodesk’s M&A Finance team is a highly visible and impactful group that plays a key role in shaping the company’s inorganic growth and strategic evolution. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior leaders and executive stakeholders
Proven ability to drive alignment, manage ambiguity, drive accountability, and deliver results in a matrixed organization

High degree of business judgment, attention to detail, and ownership

Overview

Working at Atlassian

Atlassians can choose where they work – whether in an office, from home, or a combination of the two. That way, Atlassians have more control over supporting their family, personal goals, and other priorities. We can hire people in any country where we have a legal entity.

Responsibilities

The Analytics Platform is Atlassian’s AI-ready data backbone, enabling trusted analytics across cloud environments while simplifying the underlying architecture to make data reliable, discoverable, and cost-effective at scale. By unifying a consistent data foundation, low-latency analytics, and governed access patterns, it helps both people and AI agents move from raw data to self-service insights faster and with greater confidence. The Analytics Platform is the data platform foundation for AI-native experiences such as intelligent assistants, embedded analytics, faster time to first query, and future ML use cases while preserving the reliability, permissions, and metric integrity required for enterprise-grade decision-making.

As a Technical Program Manager, reporting to a Head of TPM on the Analytics Platform team you will define product/program technical strategy. You will create long term vision for the team and associated roadmap for your areas of ownership and ensure buy in from stakeholders. You will leverage deep domain expertise and technical acumen to ensure successful delivery of large cross organization initiatives. You will demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of fundamental business challenges, shape technical requirements and collaborate with stakeholders to develop comprehensive solutions. You will utilize your technical expertise to influence solution architecture to meet the emerging needs of the business and contribute to programs and process across organizational boundaries.

What You'll Do

Analyze business objectives, customer needs, product adoption inhibitors and opportunities, industry trends, and based on these, in close collaboration with your stakeholders, define a long-term strategy and roadmap for your platform and product components.
Understand business objectives and translate them into technical systems problems that need to be prioritized solved in the current business environment.

Program Governance & Methodology
Define and maintain common program processes, templates, milestones and stage-gate reviews for R&D and product development.

Run regular program review forums and track decisions, actions and owners through to closure.
Drive continuous improvement based on lessons learned across programs.

Support capacity planning for R&D and Operations resources across programs.

Lead alignment across R&D, Product, Operations, Quality, Sales and Customer Support, resolve conflicting priorities and escalate when needed.
Serve as the senior escalation point for critical customer programs and escalations.
Partner with Sales and Business Development so program priorities and forecasts support commercial objectives.

Programs delivered against committed milestones, quality and launch targets across the portfolio.
Accurate, timely visibility of program health, risks and dependencies for senior management.

En tant que Project Manager – AI & Data Transformation, vous coordonnez et optimisez la réalisation, le déploiement et la montée en puissance des modèles d’IA/GenAI et des solutions axées sur les données au sein des projets de transformation compliance et business connexes de Belfius (avec un focus central actuel sur KYC, AML, S&E). Vous travaillez dans une équipe transversale et assurez l’orientation entre les équipes data science, IT, compliance et les parties prenantes business afin de réaliser une adoption de l’IA efficace, conforme et à fort impact.

Vous veillez à une intégration fluide des modèles d’IA (en collaboration avec des équipes data science distinctes) dans les processus existants, surveillez les performances et optimisez les stratégies de déploiement afin de répondre à la réglementation, à la gestion des risques et aux objectifs business—tout en maintenant la transparence, l’auditabilité et les standards éthiques de l’IA.

Votre job en deux mots

Responsabilités principales :

Coordination & Gouvernance
Gérez une feuille de route intégrée IA/GenAI pour les projets de transformation compliance et business, alignée sur les objectifs stratégiques de Belfius et les exigences légales.
Impliquez et orientez activement les équipes data science, IT, compliance et les partenaires externes afin d’assurer l’adhésion, l’engagement et une adoption éthique de l’IA.
Veillez au respect de la réglementation IA, des politiques internes et des directives éthiques, avec un accent sur la gestion proactive des risques (ex. : mitigation des biais, explicabilité, confidentialité des données).
Coordonnez les dépendances et synergies entre les initiatives IA/GenAI, les projets compliance (KYC, AML) et les processus business afin d’éviter les duplications et de maximiser l’efficacité.

Collaboration & Optimisation des processus
Collaborez étroitement avec les équipes business pour traduire les besoins en solutions IA (ex. : automatisation des contrôles KYC, amélioration de la détection de fraude).
Créez des tableaux de bord/procès-verbaux pour suivre l’impact de l’IA sur les résultats business (ex. : moins de faux positifs, onboarding plus rapide).
Proposez des améliorations aux workflows IA, aux outils et aux modèles de collaboration sur base des données de performance.

Pilotage axé sur les données & technique
Travaillez en étroite collaboration avec les équipes data science pour surveiller les performances des modèles, réentraîner les algorithmes et garantir l’amélioration continue.
Collaborez avec les équipes IT et cybersécurité pour sécuriser l’infrastructure IA, les pipelines de données et les environnements de déploiement.
Promouvez l’utilisation responsable de l’IA, y compris la détection des biais, les évaluations d’équité et le reporting de transparence.
Exploitez l’analyse de données et les tableaux de bord pour suivre l’impact de l’IA sur les résultats business, l’efficacité compliance et l’expérience client.

Pas besoin d’être un oiseau rare

Chez nous, vous pouvez vous distinguer et révéler le meilleur de vous-même si vous répondez aux critères suivants :

Expérience & Connaissances :

Minimum 2 ans d’expérience pratique en développement de modèles IA/ML, déploiement ou data science, de préférence dans les services financiers, la compliance ou les secteurs réglementés.
Expérience avec les outils GenAI (ex. : LLMs, RAG, Copilot) et le prompt engineering pour des applications compliance.
Familiarité avec la réglementation compliance (AMLD, RGPD, MiFID) et les processus bancaires (KYC, monitoring des opérations) est un atout.

Compétences :

Esprit orienté résolution de problèmes pour déboguer les modèles, optimiser les performances et réagir aux nouveaux défis.
Solides compétences en communication pour expliquer les concepts IA à des parties prenantes non techniques (ex. : Compliance Officers, équipes business).
Précision pour la qualité des données, la validation des modèles et le respect de la réglementation.
Proactif et collaboratif—capable de travailler de manière autonome tout en impliquant des équipes transversales.
Volonté d’apprentissage continu pour rester à la pointe des tendances, outils et réglementations IA.

Compétences linguistiques :

Néerlandais ou français : courant (oral et écrit).
Anglais : excellente maîtrise (documentation technique, collaboration internationale).

Belfius prend soin de ses talents

Outre la possibilité de faire votre chemin dans un job qui vous plaît, nous vous offrons un contrat à temps plein à durée indéterminée avec :

Un salaire attractif complété par une offre innovante vous octroyant un budget à utiliser selon vos préférences personnelles (p. ex. voiture, vélo, PC, smartphone, tablette, loyer ou crédit hypothécaire sous certaines conditions) et des avantages extralégaux, tels que des chèques-repas, des avantages sur les produits et services internes, une assurance hospitalisation et une assurance groupe.
Des possibilités de développement par le biais d'un large éventail de formations et des opportunités de carrière dans l’ensemble du groupe Belfius.
Un bon équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie privée grâce à des horaires flexibles, à la combinaison du travail au bureau et à domicile et un nombre attractif de jours de congé.
Un lieu de travail moderne au cœur de Bruxelles, avec une salle de sport branchée, un délicieux restaurant sain et des espaces de réunion confortables, le tout à quelques pas de la rue commerciale, de la gare Bruxelles-Nord et de la station métro Rogier.

Create clear planning documents together with involved departments
Proactive identification and management of relevant dependencies (both within as well as cross departments and 3rd parties) in order to minimize risks and challenges.

Skills/Qualifications:

InfoBeans is looking for an experienced Technical Project Manager with a strong engineering background, AI/ML expertise, and proven leadership capabilities to manage and lead a 40+ member engineering team supporting BFSI.

The ideal candidate will combine technical depth, project and delivery management, client engagement, and a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) mindset. Beyond managing delivery against defined requirements, the candidate will work closely with client stakeholders to understand business challenges, identify opportunities for innovation, and rapidly translate ideas into working technical solutions using AI, automation, and modern engineering practices.

The role requires hands-on familiarity with Python, Django, Databticks, Spec-Driven Development (SDD), and agentic AI development. The candidate should be capable of engaging with business and technology stakeholders, guiding engineering teams through solution discovery and prototyping, and converting successful POCs into scalable, production-ready solutions.

Key Responsibilities
1. Technical Project & Delivery Management
Lead and manage a 50+ member engineering team, ensuring predictable delivery, quality, productivity, and client satisfaction.

Establish effective engineering processes, delivery standards, performance monitoring, and continuous improvement practices.

Present technical proposals, POC demonstrations, solution roadmaps, delivery updates, and business-value outcomes.
Identify opportunities to expand existing engagements through innovation, solution-led discussions, and measurable business outcomes.
Collaborate with account leadership and business development teams to shape proposals, estimates, solution approaches, and new engineering opportunities.
Track and communicate business impact through metrics such as productivity improvement, cycle-time reduction, quality, cost optimization, and value delivered.

Experience: 15+ years in the IT industry, with substantial experience in technical project management, engineering leadership, and enterprise application delivery.
Team Leadership: Proven experience managing large engineering teams, preferably 4050+ members, in complex client environments.
Programming: Strong hands-on experience with Python and practical exposure to Django or related Python web frameworks.
AI/ML: Demonstrated experience building AI/ML proof of concepts, with the ability to translate business problems into working technical prototypes.
Generative AI & Agentic Development: Practical exposure to LLM-based applications, AI agents, agentic workflows, and AI-assisted software development.
Spec-Driven Development: Understanding and practical experience with SDD, including translating requirements into specifications, implementation plans, and testable engineering outcomes.
FDE Mindset: Experience engaging directly with clients, conducting discovery, solving ambiguous problems, prototyping solutions, and driving ideas toward implementation.
Technical Architecture: Good understanding of application architecture, APIs, integrations, databases, cloud platforms, CI/CD, testing, and production-readiness practices.
Delivery Management: Strong capabilities in project planning, estimation, risk management, governance, stakeholder alignment, and delivery execution.
Communication: Excellent verbal, written, presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

Exposure to cloud platforms, data engineering, RAG-based applications, AI evaluation, observability, and secure enterprise AI adoption.
Experience converting innovation initiatives and POCs into production solutions or larger engineering engagements.
Relevant technical, cloud, AI/ML, or project-management certifications are an advantage.

Successful leadership and delivery of the 50+ member engineering team.
Improved delivery predictability, engineering productivity, quality, and client satisfaction.
Identification and validation of high-value business problems through client discovery.
Successful development and demonstration of AI/ML POCs and agentic solutions.
Adoption of SDD and AI-assisted engineering practices across relevant teams.
Conversion of validated POCs into production implementations and incremental engineering opportunities.
Strong client relationships and recognition as a trusted technical and business partner.

We are looking for a technology leader who is not limited to managing plans, schedules, and status reports. new_jobs.description:
Job Number: R0251525

All-Source Intelligence Analyst, Mid

The Opportunity:

With all the information available today, it takes a skilled intelligence analyst to know how to find and interpret the best data to give their clients the right answers. With the critical decisions made in our military every day, we need an intel analyst like you to do just that. As an intelligence analyst, you use your specialized regional and functional experience and attention to detail to develop intelligence reports to give your client the actionable intelligence and context they need. If you have strong analytical skills and a problem-solving mindset, we have an opportunity to use those skills to support our warfighters.

As an intelligence analyst on our team, you’ll help your client understand the operational environment. Using your understanding of various collection platforms, you’ll explore new data sources, develop effective queries, and combine information from disparate sources, including SIGINT, GEOINT, OSINT, MASINT, and open source. You’ll validate information and apply client tradecraft as you build assessments for senior policymakers. As the authority on your region, your client will look to you for time-critical recommendations, often under pressure.

This is a chance to grow your expertise, develop new skills in intelligence analysis, and share your methodologies with other analysts. We focus on growing as a team to deliver the best support to our customers, so you’ll have resources for mentoring and learning new skills and tools.

Work with us as we provide the right information at the right time to support the critical needs of our warfighters.

Join us. The world can’t wait.

You Have:

Experience with ICD 203 compliant intelligence analysis
Experience with EUCOM AOR
Knowledge of the IC or Combatant Command environment
Ability to develop high-quality deliverables tailored to senior policymakers or defense stakeholders, including complex written products and formal or informal briefings
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
Ability to support shift work
TS/SCI clearance with a polygraph
Bachelor's degree with 3 years of experience with analysis or 7+ years of experience with analysis

Nice If You Have:

Experience working in a Joint Staff environment
Experience briefing senior defense clients

Clearance:

Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; TS/SCI clearance with polygraph is required.

Compensation

At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disability, financial, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusive of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.

About The Role & Team

The Senior Research Analyst will support IDC's EMEA Partnering Ecosystems practice, helping technology vendors, distributors, cloud providers, systems integrators, and ecosystem participants understand how partner business models, ecosystem strategies, channel programs, and go-to-market approaches are evolving across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

The role will contribute to IDC research covering partner ecosystems, strategic alliances, marketplaces, distribution, channel strategy, and emerging AI-driven ecosystem trends. Working closely with IDC's worldwide Partnering Ecosystems, Alliances & Channels team, the analyst will support primary research, develop written research content, contribute to custom consulting projects, and assist in delivering actionable insights to clients.

This position combines qualitative and quantitative research, market analysis, survey development, executive interviews, and content creation. The role offers an opportunity to work closely with senior analysts and industry leaders while contributing to research and thought leadership on the evolution of technology ecosystems, partner-led growth, AI, marketplaces, alliances, route-to-market innovation, and changing partner business models.

What You’ll Do

Conduct primary and secondary research on partner ecosystems, alliances, marketplaces, and channel-related topics.
Support survey design, data analysis, executive interviews, and research projects.
